rules.description: GitHub titles its pages "GitHub - owner/repo: description · GitHub" and "Issue title · Issue #1 · owner/repo · GitHub"
A repository's page: "owner/repo: description" reads "repo: description"
An issue's or pull request's page: "Title · Issue #1 · owner/repo" and "Title by author · Pull Request #1 · owner/repo" read "Title · owner/repo#1"
